subject: Bump: EOQ timing + priority for Redwood Dedicated
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@finflow.ai>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@finflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — EOQ priority and approval timing?

Hi Claire / Tom —

Just bumping this — as we get closer to June 30 I wanted to check whether this is still on your EOQ priority list or if timing has shifted. If budget/approval is still on track, we can lock in the quoted pricing and reserve a short sandbox window for next week to prove perf. If priorities changed, no problem — a quick note on timing helps us plan next steps and keep the offer aligned.

If helpful, Marissa and I can do a 15-min procurement sync with Tom to walk through the SOW and answer any questions to accelerate sign-off.

Thanks,
Aditya

(Short one-line replies totally fine.)

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@finflow.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@finflow.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check — EOQ priority and approval timing?

Aditya —

Thanks for the ping. Quick update: finance will review next week but there are a couple of internal items ahead of this. I'm pushing for EOQ but can't promise. Tom is our procurement owner and will have the confirmed timeline.

Cheers,
Claire
Head of Product | FinFlow.ai

From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@finflow.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@finflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check — EOQ priority and approval timing?

Aditya —

Appreciate the follow-up. FYI priorities shifted late last week; finance put a temporary hold on new procurements until they close a couple internal projects. We're still very interested and Claire is advocating, but I don't have an approval number for EOQ. Expect clearer status by July 10.

Please consider this a hold rather than a no. If you have flexibility on quoted start dates/pricing after EOQ, let us know — otherwise we'll reconnect the week of July 13.

Thanks,
Tom Rivera
VP, Infrastructure | FinFlow.ai
Tom.Rivera@finflow.ai
